comment: Per-repo floor for ws-mixer-go's own conformance run (docs/MIGRATION.md section 2.4/2.5): go-server via cmd/conformance-adapter's acceptBackend (wsmixer.AcceptConn), go-client via wsmixer.Dial. Values carried over from the monorepo's conformance/COUNTS.json floors at the pre-split base SHA. Other SDKs' keys (js-server, js-client, go->go, go->js) are not exercised by this repo's runner invocation and are intentionally omitted -- checkCounts only enforces keys present here and actually exercised by the run.
